card: Fixes an intermittent failure in the p2p_tx_download.py functional test by mocking time on nodes[1]. Without mocktime, wall-clock advancement during test_block_inv can cause the node to request a transaction from an unresponsive test peer rather than nodes[0], causing sync_mempools() to time out and fail. This eliminates a source of CI test flakiness.
evidence: PR description and commit e556dc1ef1: 'Because nodes[1] time was not mocked in test_block_inv, it was possible for wall clock to advance 2s by the time nodes[0] had delivered a tx announcement to it. Then, nodes[1] would request the tx from a test peer, never receive the tx, and fail in sync_mempools().'
problem: In test_block_inv, nodes[1] did not have its time mocked. If 2 seconds of wall-clock time passed before nodes[0] delivered a transaction announcement, nodes[1] would request the transaction from a test peer instead, never receive it, and trigger a test failure in sync_mempools().

risk.why: A mistake would only cause functional test failures or mask test assertions in p2p transaction download testing.

scope_notes: Small functional test fix (+4/-1) in a single test file.
summary: Fixes an intermittent test failure in the p2p_tx_download.py functional test. In test_block_inv, it sets mocktime on nodes[1] to keep wall clock progression from causing unintended transaction download requests.
